_about: H-eye (1 Oct play-test D15h, decision 27; Sprint 11 s11-clinic, js/clinic/heal/games/eye.js): drops in a front close-up (only the sore eye red, the dropper over it; they close at the count by themselves, no Done), then the eye test as flash cards (Zafar, 21 Oct): the chart and its versions A/B are retired. She sits close up covering one eye (art testA); the doctor holds up one big shared word card at a time on a stand; she says her guess every 1.5 s; the child taps big haa or na, or says it (the mic); the first card is the demo, four are judged. The cards are Cook's words the family has recorded (the code's POOL; WAITING words join once recorded). After a misread the dropper hangs over her eye (CLN-62). Sides are said only in the diagnosis (D10). The older keys below (numbers, chart_nouns, levels) are the first design's notes, kept for Mum's word list; the game's levels are in its code (K).

1._note: Drops (the count; the sore eye shows, so no side row) + three chart calls, rows of 3, 4, 5. Lines come one at a time.

3._note: + the patch on THE OTHER eye (the only reversed side in any mode); five calls with wadho/nindho and a nar row.
